resources.string: ompweb records your voice and sends it to your server for transcription. The recording stays on the server until the transcript is claimed or discarded.
ompweb uses this phone\'s speech recognition. The audio is processed on the device; only the recognized text is inserted into your message.
Microphone access is denied. Allow it for ompweb in Android Settings to dictate.
Recording is not available on this device
The server cannot transcribe (speech-to-text is not configured). The recording is kept on this phone, but on-device dictation cannot reuse it.
Speech recognition on this phone is not available (needs Android 12+ and the offline language pack). Use server transcription or install the language pack.
On-device speech recognition could not run. Try again.
This phone cannot recognize that language on-device. Pick another dictation language.
The on-device language pack for %1$s is not installed and could not be downloaded. Install the language data in Android settings, or pick another dictation language.
The on-device language pack for %1$s is not installed yet. Android is downloading it — try dictation again in a moment.
Speech recognition is busy. Try again in a moment.
Speech recognition did not start on this phone. Try again.
Speech recognition stopped before it could hear you. Try again.
